notes: 15 cards: 4 cadence cards defined by their exact chord pair so no two fronts collide, 5 term-to-definition (power chord, diatonic, chromatic, inversion, modulation), 2 Roman-numeral notation cards, 2 chord-function cards, plus 2 example-to-feature cards on the set work (chorus progression, chorus key). Dropped subdominant, secondary chords, atonal and modal to keep the deck inside 15 and to avoid interference between the near-identical chord-function fronts.
